params.body:
The capability for shanedeconinck.be named `ShaneDeconinck/shanedeconinck`, and the gateway rightly refused the push on `ShaneDeconinck/shanedeconinck.be`: the principal had signed for a repository that does not exist. Same for trustedagentic.ai. `Capability::repoOf` stopped at the first dot; it now keeps the name whole and drops only a trailing `.git`, a trailing slash, or a path after the repository (`/tree/main`). Five cases in the test.

This also concerned Elixir's own hands: an elixir-fix on shanedeconinck.be would have been refused the same way.

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
params.title: Een repositorynaam mag een punt dragen
